description_en: You can call OnsMessageDetail to query the details of a specific message
description_zh: 调用OnsMessageDetail查询某条消息的具体信息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-message-detail --instance-id MQ_INST_184681981000000_BXig0x6A --topic test-mq_topic --msg-id 1E0578FE110F18B4AAC235C0000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsMessageDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RocketMQ 版实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The topic of the message to query
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message to query. This is the message ID
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息的ID，即Message ID
parameters.name: msg_id

Body.description_en: The message body, which is a Base64-encoded string
Body.description_zh: 消息体内容经过Base 64算法加密后的字符串

BodyCRC.description_en: The cyclic redundancy check (CRC) value of the message body

BodyStr.description_en: The content of the message body

BornHost.description_en: The client instance that generated the message
BornHost.description_zh: 生成该消息的客户端实例

BornTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the message was generated. Unit: milliseconds
BornTimestamp.description_zh: 消息生成的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
InstanceId.description_zh: 云消息队列 RocketMQ 版实例ID

Name.description_en:
The message attribute. Valid values:

TRACE_ON: Indicates whether a message trace exists.

MSG_REGION: The region ID of the instance that contains the message topic.

__MESSAGE_DECODED_TIME: The time when the message was decoded.

__BORNHOST: The IP address of the producer client.

UNIQ_KEY: The unique identifier of the message. This is the message ID.

For more information, see [Terms]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）
Name.description_zh:
消息属性。取值说明如下：

TRACE_ON：是否有消息轨迹。
MSG_REGION：消息的Topic所属实例的地域ID。
__MESSAGE_DECODED_TIME：消息被解码的时间。
__BORNHOST：消息生产者客户端的IP地址。
UNIQ_KEY：消息的唯一标识，即Message ID。

更多概念信息请参见[名词解释]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）

Value.description_en: The value of the message attribute

ReconsumeTimes.description_en: The number of times the message consumption is retried

StoreHost.description_en: The server instance where the message is stored
StoreHost.description_zh: 存储该消息的服务器实例

StoreSize.description_en: The size of the message. Unit: KB

StoreTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the message was stored on the server-side. Unit: milliseconds
StoreTimestamp.description_zh: 消息被服务端存储的时间戳。单位：毫秒

Topic.description_en: The topic to which the message belongs

RequestId.description_en: A common parameter. The ID of the request. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
